warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Studies have shown that Bosutinib can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman. Animal studies have shown reproductive toxicities. Therefore, BONITAR 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and in women who think they are pregnant.
?Women of reproductive potential should use effective contraception during therapy and for at least two weeks after the last dose. ?
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED
Breastfeeding is not recommended while taking bosutinib and for at least two weeks after the final dose due to potential serious adverse reactions in nursing infants. ?
Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION
Patients should exercise caution when driving or operating machinery, as bosutinib can cause side effects like dizziness or visual disturbances that may impair the ability to perform these tasks safely.
Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While specific interactions between bosutinib and alcohol are not well-documented, it's advisable to limit alcohol intake. Alcohol can affect liver function, and since bosutinib is metabolized in the liver, concurrent use may increase the risk of liver-related side effects.?
Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Bosutinib can cause kidney problems. Therefore, before taking BONITAR 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of kidney issues. Regular monitoring of kidney function is recommended during therapy.
Liver
CONTRAINDICATED
Patients with liver impairment should not use bosutinib. Liver function tests should be conducted before starting treatment and monitored regularly thereafter.
Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED
Do not take BONITAR 100 TABLET if you are allergic to bosutinib or any of its ingredients.
Lungs
CONTRAINDICATED
Bosutinib may cause fluid retention, leading to swelling and, in severe cases, fluid accumulation in the lungs (pleural effusion). Therefore, BONITAR 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems. Report any new or worsening respiratory symptoms to your doctor promptly.
Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION
Bosutinib has been associated with cardiac events, including arrhythmias and QT interval prolongation. Patients with a history of heart problems should use BONITAR 100 TABLET cautiously and under close medical supervision.
Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
The safety and efficacy of bosutinib in pediatric patients have not been established. Therefore, the use of BONITAR 100 TABLET in individuals under 18 years of age is not recommended.
Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION
Elderly patients (65 years and older) may experience more frequent adverse reactions. Close monitoring is advised, and dose adjustments may be necessary based on tolerability.

introduction:
Introduction About MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION

MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION Works

MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION is a monoclonal antibody. It destroys the immune cells (B-cells) that triggers cancer formation. It also reduces the production of certain chemicals within the body (such as rheumatoid factor, T-cells, cytokines) that causes inflammation, pain and swelling which helps in managing various autoimmune diseases.

MABTHERA 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ABEVMY 100MG INJECTION

ABEVMY 100MG INJECTION contains Bevacizumab, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used in adult patients with fluoropyrimidine (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic cancer in the large bowel (colon or rectum). It is also used with Paclitaxel or Capecitabine (chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic breast cancer in adult patients.

ABEVMY 100MG INJECTION is used with a chemotherapy regimen containing platinum to manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer without epidermal growth factor receptor (a mutated protein responsible for causing cancer in a cell) and with Erlotinib (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor (in cancer cells) in adult patients.

This medicine is indicated for use to manage metastatic kidney cancer along with interferon (chemotherapy medicine), which is also indicated for use with carboplatin, gemcitabine, and/or carboplatin and Paclitaxel (chemotherapy medicine) to manage recurrent advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in adult patients.

This medicine is also used to manage persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with or without Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, or Paclitaxel and Topotecan in adult patients. ABEVMY 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Bevacizumab, Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell products, and/or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have recently undergone major operations or surgery.

Before receiving ABEVMY 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for an invasive dental management or surgery and/or suffer from conditions such as inflammation inside the abdomen, uncontrolled high blood pressure, dental problems, kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatic injury).

Introduction About ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION

ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION contains Bevacizumab, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used in adult patients with fluoropyrimidine (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic cancer in the large bowel (colon or rectum). It is also used with Paclitaxel or Capecitabine (chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic breast cancer in adult patients.

ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION is used with a chemotherapy regimen containing platinum to manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer without epidermal growth factor receptor (a mutated protein responsible for causing cancer in a cell) and with Erlotinib (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor (in cancer cells) in adult patients.

This medicine is indicated for use to manage metastatic kidney cancer along with interferon (chemotherapy medicine), which is also indicated for use with carboplatin, gemcitabine, and/or carboplatin and Paclitaxel (chemotherapy medicine) to manage recurrent advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in adult patients.

This medicine is also used to manage persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with or without Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, or Paclitaxel and Topotecan in adult patients. ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Bevacizumab, Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell products, and/or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have recently undergone major operations or surgery.

Before receiving ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for an invasive dental management or surgery and/or suffer from conditions such as inflammation inside the abdomen, uncontrolled high blood pressure, dental problems, kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatic injury).

ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or in women planning for pregnancy since it may cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also not recommended for use by breast-feeding women since it may interfere with the growth and development of the baby.

ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the safety and efficacy of the medicine are not established in this age group. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving ABEVMY 400MG INJECTION are constipation, loss of appetite, fever, eye problems (such as an increase in the production of tears), changes in speech or sense of taste, runny nose, and/or loss of body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION is used with a chemotherapy regimen containing platinum to manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer without epidermal growth factor receptor (a mutated protein responsible for causing cancer in a cell) and with Erlotinib (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor (in cancer cells) in adult patients.

This medicine is indicated for use to manage metastatic kidney cancer along with interferon (chemotherapy medicine), which is also indicated for use with carboplatin, gemcitabine, and/or carboplatin and Paclitaxel (chemotherapy medicine) to manage recurrent advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in adult patients.

This medicine is also used to manage persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with or without Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, or Paclitaxel and Topotecan in adult patients. KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Bevacizumab, Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell products, and/or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have recently undergone major operations or surgery.

Before receiving KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for an invasive dental management or surgery and/or suffer from conditions such as inflammation inside the abdomen, uncontrolled high blood pressure, dental problems, kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatic injury).

KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or in women planning for pregnancy since it may cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also not recommended for use by breast-feeding women since it may interfere with the growth and development of the baby.

KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the safety and efficacy of the medicine are not established in this age group. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION are constipation, loss of appetite, fever, eye problems (such as an increase in the production of tears), changes in speech or sense of taste, runny nose, and/or loss of body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION Works

KRABEVA 100MG INJECTION works by reducing microvascular growth of tumour blood vessels which leads to reduced blood flow to the tumour cells resulting in its death thus managing the disease and managing its spread to other parts of the body in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET

SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET contains Sorafenib which belongs to the group of medicines called Multikinase inhibitors. It is used to manage liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma), and kidney cancer (advanced renal cell carcinoma) at an advanced stage when standard therapy has not helped to stop the disease or considered unsuitable. SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET is also used to manage differentiated thyroid cancer that is not responding to radioactive iodine management.  

SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with squamous cell lung cancer.  SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney disease, high blood pressure, and heart diseases such as abnormal heart rhythm disorders like prolonged QT interval, diabetes, and bleeding problems. Consult your doctor before taking SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET

SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy or if you think you could become pregnant, use adequate contraception during management with this medicine. SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it interferes with the growth of the developing baby. Contact your doctor for advice before taking SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET  

The safety and efficacy of SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET in children and adolescents aged below 18 years have not yet been established. SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney failure. Contact your doctor before taking SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET. The most common side effects of taking SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, constipation, weakness or tiredness, hair loss (alopecia) or rash. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET Works

SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET is an oral multi-kinase inhibitor which blocks tumour cell growth. It targets several enzymes on the surface of cancer cells and also targets within the cell. Several of these targets are thought to be involved in angiogenesis (making of blood vessels). SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET works by slowing down the rate of growth of cancer cells and cutting off the blood supply that keeps cancer cells growing.

How to use SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET

Take SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not take SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET with high fat meals, as this may make the medicine less effective. If you intend to have a high fat meal, take SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after the meal. Consult your doctor for advice.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of SORAFENAT 200MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage are severe diarrhoea and skin reactions.

introduction:
Introduction About IMANIB 100MG TABLET

IMANIB 100MG TABLET contains Imatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in adults, children and adolescents to manage chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named myeloid cells) start growing out of control) and philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (Ph-positive ALL) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named lymphoblasts) start growing out of control).

Also, it is used in adults only to manage myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative diseases (MDS/MPD) (a group of blood diseases in which some blood cells start growing out of control), hyper eosinophilic syndrome (HES) and/or chronic eosinophilic leukaemia (CEL) (a blood diseases in which some blood cells (named eosinophils) start growing out of control), gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST) (cancer of the stomach and bowels) and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) (cancer of the tissue beneath the skin in which some cells start growing out of control).

Before taking IMANIB 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney, liver or heart problems, hepatitis B infection and thrombotic microangiopathy (symptoms include bruising, bleeding, fever, fatigue and confusion).

IMANIB 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. IMANIB 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IMANIB 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, weight gain, loss of appetite, disturbed sense of taste, blurred vision and weakness. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (Ph-positive ALL)
Hyper-eosinophilic syndrome (HES) and/or chronic eosinophilic leukaemia (CEL)
usesDetails:

Manage adults, children and adolescents for:

Chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML)

Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative diseases (MDS/MPD)

Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP)
mechanismOfAction:
How IMANIB 100MG TABLET Works

IMANIB 100MG TABLET is a protein-tyrosine kinase inhibitor. Tyrosine kinases are proteins which act as chemical messengers that are used by the cancer cells to signal each other for their growth, therefore this medicine works by blocking the enzyme which stops the cancer cells from growing.

Take IMANIB 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the IMANIB 100MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Bortenat 3.5mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION contains Bortezomib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used in adult patients alone or with pegylated liposomal doxorubicin/dexamethasone to manage progressive multiple myeloma when anticancer therapy or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease.

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is also used in adult patients with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone to manage unmanageed mantle cell lymphoma when hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that occurs in plasma cells (white blood cells) and is generally characterized by symptoms such as bone pain, nausea, constipation, and loss of appetite. Mantle Cell Lymphoma is a rare form of cancer that affects the lymphatic system and is generally characterized by symptoms such as loss of appetite, fever, nausea, and/or vomiting.

Your doctor may advise you to do regular blood tests to check your blood counts before and during management with BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION. It is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung or heart disease.

Before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have bleeding problems, diarrhea, constipation, nausea or vomiting, shortness of breath or cough, seizures, congestive heart failure, mild or moderate renal impairment, and/or moderate or severe liver impairment.

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is also not indicated for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION are dizziness, increased heartbeat, sweating, abnormal vision, paresthesia (burning or pickling sensation), muscle pain, and headache. Inform your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen during or after management with BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.
uses: To manage progressive multiple myeloma when anticancer therapy or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease (alone or in combination with pegylated liposomal doxorubicin/dexamethasone)
To manage unmanageed mantle cell lymphoma (with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone when hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease)

To manage progressive multiple myeloma when anticancer therapy or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease (alone or in combination with pegylated liposomal doxorubicin/dexamethasone)
To manage unmanageed mantle cell lymphoma (with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone when hematopoietic stem cell transplantation becomes unsuitable to manage the disease)
mechanismOfAction:
How BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION Works

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION works by inhibiting proteasomes (enzymes responsible for breaking down proteins into smaller compounds for cells), which leads to imbalance in the cancer cell, thus resulting in its destruction and thereby managing multiple myeloma and mantle cell lymphoma in affected individuals.

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into the skin as a subcutaneous injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy or by women planning for pregnancy. It should be used with caution in women with childbearing potential who should use effective contraceptive measures before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION. 

Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, tired, syncope (fainting), and/or blurred vision after receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as mild to moderate renal impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Liver
USE WITH CAUTION

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with moderate or severe liver problems, such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not receive BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION if you are allergic to bortezomib, boron, or any other ingredients of this medicine. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Lungs
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung problems. It should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis B virus disease. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have severe heart problems. BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart problems such as congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administering BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION to your child.

USE WITH CAUTION

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Omeprazole (used to manage indigestion and heartburn)
Dexamethasone (used to manage inflammation and severe allergies)
Melphalan, prednisone (used to manage multiple myeloma)
Ritonavir (used to manage HIV infection)
Rifampicin (an antibiotic used to manage bacterial infections)
Carbamazepine, phenytoin, or phenobarbital (used to manage epilepsy)
St. John’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Oral antidiabetics (used to manage diabetes) Ex. metformin, glimepiride
Adalimumab (used to manage pain and swelling due to arthritis)
Lomitapide (used to manage cholesterol levels)

Overdosage:

BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so you are unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms of BORTENAT 3.5MG INJECTION, such as the acute onset of symptomatic hypotension (low blood pressure while standing up from a lying position) and thrombocytopenia (a condition marked by a low platelet count).

introduction:
Introduction About CANMAB 50MG INJECTION

CANMAB 50MG INJECTION contains Trastuzumab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage breast cancer and stomach cancer. It can be used either alone or in combination with other anticancer drugs (such as paclitaxel, cisplatin, docetaxel, 5-fluorouracil, capecitabine) or hormonal drugs (such as tamoxifen, anastrozole) to achieve better results.

CANMAB 50MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or by a trained professional into your vein or beneath the skin. It is suitable for use in patients with high levels of human epidermal growth factor 2 (HER2) or hormone receptor positive metastatic breast cancer (cancer this is more sensitive for hormonal changes).

Before receiving CANMAB 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as heart attack, heart valve disease, or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension as a precaution.

CANMAB 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving CANMAB 50MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CANMAB 50MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are increased infections, sore throat, mouth ulcers, skin rashes, nausea, stomach upset, lack of sleep, weight loss, tingling and numbness of hands and feet, muscle pain, joint pain, hair loss, shakiness and increased sweating. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANMAB 50MG INJECTION

It is used to manage:

Breast cancer (early and advanced)
Stomach cancer (advanced)
mechanismOfAction:
How CANMAB 50MG INJECTION Works

CANMAB 50MG INJECTION is a monoclonal antibody. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (HER2) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CANMAB 50MG INJECTION

CANMAB 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CADINIB 40MG TABLET

CADINIB 40MG TABLET contains Imatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in adults, children and adolescents to manage chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named myeloid cells) start growing out of control) and philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (Ph-positive ALL) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named lymphoblasts) start growing out of control).

Also, it is used in adults only to manage myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative diseases (MDS/MPD) (a group of blood diseases in which some blood cells start growing out of control), hyper eosinophilic syndrome (HES) and/or chronic eosinophilic leukaemia (CEL) (a blood diseases in which some blood cells (named eosinophils) start growing out of control), gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST) (cancer of the stomach and bowels) and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) (cancer of the tissue beneath the skin in which some cells start growing out of control).

Before taking CADINIB 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney, liver or heart problems, hepatitis B infection and thrombotic microangiopathy (symptoms include bruising, bleeding, fever, fatigue and confusion).

CADINIB 40MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CADINIB 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking CADINIB 40MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, weight gain, loss of appetite, disturbed sense of taste, blurred vision and weakness. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

name: PAZIB 400 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About PAZIB 400 TABLET

PAZIB 400 TABLET contains Pazopanib which belongs to the group of medicines called Protein kinase inhibitors. It is used in the management of kidney cancer (that has advanced or spread to other organs) and soft tissue sarcoma.

Soft tissue sarcoma is a type of cancer that affects the supportive tissues of the body. It can occur in the muscles, blood vessels, fat tissues or other tissues that support, surround and protect the organs.

Your doctor may ask you to undergo certain diagnostic tests to check the functioning of your liver, kidney and heart and may monitor your blood pressure prior to and while you take PAZIB 400 TABLET.

Before taking [GBNKEWYORD], consult with your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver diseases, had lung problems, thyroid problems, bleeding or blood clotting issues, stomach or bowel problems (perforation or fistula), aneurysm (enlargement and weakening of a blood vessel wall) or have high blood pressure.

PAZIB 400 TABLET is not recommended in pregnant and breastfeeding women. PAZIB 400 TABLET is not recommended in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult with your doctor before taking PAZIB 400 TABLET.

The most common side effects of PAZIB 400 TABLET are indigestion, bloating, flatulence, nosebleed, dry mouth, mouth ulcers or dizziness. Consult with your doctor if the symptoms do not improve or get worse.
uses: Sarcoma (a cancer that begins in bones or in any soft tissues of the body)

mechanismOfAction:
How PAZIB 400 TABLET Works

PAZIB 400 TABLET works by stopping the activity of various growth factor receptors associated with blood vessel formation and tumour cell proliferation. It inhibits the activity of few other factors that are responsible for the multiplication of cancer cells and hence manages the growth and spread of cancer cells.

How to use PAZIB 400 TABLET

Take PAZIB 400 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow PAZIB 400 TABLET along with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the proper dose and duration of PAZIB 400 TABLET for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION

CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION Works

CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION kills the dividing cancer cells by inhibition of their DNA (hereditary material) synthesis.
usageDetails:
How to use CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION

CITAFINE 1400MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and surface area and disease condition.

name: PAZOCI 200 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About PAZOCI 200 TABLET

PAZOCI 200 TABLET contains Pazopanib which belongs to the group of medicines called Protein kinase inhibitors. It is used in the management of kidney cancer (that has advanced or spread to other organs) and soft tissue sarcoma.

Soft tissue sarcoma is a type of cancer that affects the supportive tissues of the body. It can occur in the muscles, blood vessels, fat tissues or other tissues that support, surround and protect the organs.

Your doctor may ask you to undergo certain diagnostic tests to check the functioning of your liver, kidney and heart and may monitor your blood pressure prior to and while you take PAZOCI 200 TABLET.

Before taking [GBNKEWYORD], consult with your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver diseases, had lung problems, thyroid problems, bleeding or blood clotting issues, stomach or bowel problems (perforation or fistula), aneurysm (enlargement and weakening of a blood vessel wall) or have high blood pressure.

PAZOCI 200 TABLET is not recommended in pregnant and breastfeeding women. PAZOCI 200 TABLET is not recommended in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult with your doctor before taking PAZOCI 200 TABLET.

The most common side effects of PAZOCI 200 TABLET are indigestion, bloating, flatulence, nosebleed, dry mouth, mouth ulcers or dizziness. Consult with your doctor if the symptoms do not improve or get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How PAZOCI 200 TABLET Works

PAZOCI 200 TABLET works by stopping the activity of various growth factor receptors associated with blood vessel formation and tumour cell proliferation. It inhibits the activity of few other factors that are responsible for the multiplication of cancer cells and hence manages the growth and spread of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use PAZOCI 200 TABLET

Take PAZOCI 200 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow PAZOCI 200 TABLET along with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the proper dose and duration of PAZOCI 200 TABLET for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE

ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE Works

ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE works by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Take ENZAMIDE 40MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Lupiximab 100mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION

LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

LUPIXIMAB 100MG INJECTION is a monoclonal antibody. It destroys the immune cells (B-cells) that triggers cancer formation. It also reduces the production of certain chemicals within the body (such as rheumatoid factor, T-cells, cytokines) that causes inflammation, pain and swelling which helps in managing various autoimmune diseases.

introduction:
Introduction About IRESSA 250MG TABLET

IRESSA 250MG TABLET contains Gefitinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is indicated in adults for the management of locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who have activating mutation of the EGFR-TK.  

It is generally characterized by symptoms such as chest pain or discomfort, persistent cough, trouble breathing, wheezing, tiredness and difficulty while swallowing which may be diagnosed as any of its type as adenocarcinoma (cancer involving the outer part of the lung), squamous cell carcinoma (cancer occurring in the centre part of the lungs) and large cell carcinoma (cancer that can occur in any part of the lung).

Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to take liver function test to assess your liver function.   

IRESSA 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Gefitinib. Before taking IRESSA 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have other lung problems, liver or kidney problems.

IRESSA 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking IRESSA 250MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking IRESSA 250MG TABLET are diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, skin reactions, loss of appetite, weakness and red or sore mouth. Consult with your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage adults with non-small cell lung cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of IRESSA 250MG TABLET
Used to manage adults with non-small cell lung cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How IRESSA 250MG TABLET Works

IRESSA 250MG TABLET works by decreasing the survival rate and proliferation of malignant cancer cells in lung tissues by blocking a protein called epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) which is responsible for the growth and spread of cancer cell thereby controlling the growth and spread of cancer cells to other parts of the body.

How to use IRESSA 250MG TABLET

Take IRESSA 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of IRESSA 250MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE contains Lenvatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE is used on its own to manage locally recurrent/metastatic thyroid cancer in adults when radioactive iodine management becomes insufficient to stop the disease.

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE is also used on its own to manage liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma) when it becomes unresectable in adult patients. It is also used together with pembrolizumab (anticancer medicine) to manage endometrial carcinoma when cancer has spread and cannot be managed by surgery/radiation management. The medicine is also indicated for use in combination with everolimus (anticancer medicine) to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (kidney cancer) in adults prior to anti-angiogenic therapy (cancer therapy).

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Lenvatinib. Before taking GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, aneurysm (enlargement and weakening of blood vessel wall), history of blood clots in your arteries, heart diseases (such as congestive heart failure, heart attack), kidney diseases (such as mild/moderate/severe renal impairment), and/or liver diseases (such as mild/moderate/severe hepatic impairment).

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE are nausea, redness, rashes, peeling of skin, weight loss, vomiting, and/or hoarseness of voice. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Manage advanced endometrial carcinoma when used with pembrolizumab (anticancer medicine) in adults in whom the cancer has spread and cannot be removed by surgery/radiation management.
Manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (kidney cancer) when used in combination with everolimus (anticancer medicine) following prior anti-angiogenic therapy in affected individuals

GLENVAS 10MG CAPSULE works by inhibiting the action of receptor tyrosine kinases (proteins responsible for development of new blood vessels) which leads to poor oxygen and nutrient supply to the cancer cell resulting in its destruction thus managing cancer in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE contains Lenvatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE is used on its own to manage locally recurrent/metastatic thyroid cancer in adults when radioactive iodine management becomes insufficient to stop the disease.

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE is also used on its own to manage liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma) when it becomes unresectable in adult patients. It is also used together with pembrolizumab (anticancer medicine) to manage endometrial carcinoma when cancer has spread and cannot be managed by surgery/radiation management. The medicine is also indicated for use in combination with everolimus (anticancer medicine) to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (kidney cancer) in adults prior to anti-angiogenic therapy (cancer therapy).

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Lenvatinib. Before taking LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, aneurysm (enlargement and weakening of blood vessel wall), history of blood clots in your arteries, heart diseases (such as congestive heart failure, heart attack), kidney diseases (such as mild/moderate/severe renal impairment), and/or liver diseases (such as mild/moderate/severe hepatic impairment).

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE are nausea, redness, rashes, peeling of skin, weight loss, vomiting, and/or hoarseness of voice. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage locally recurrent/metastatic thyroid cancer in adult patients.

mechanismOfAction:
How LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE Works

LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE works by inhibiting the action of receptor tyrosine kinases (proteins responsible for development of new blood vessels) which leads to poor oxygen and nutrient supply to the cancer cell resulting in its destruction thus managing cancer in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE

Take LENTYKINE 10 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LUPIPARP 100 Tablet 60's
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIPARP 100 TABLET

LUPIPARP 100 TABLET is used in the management of various types of cancer such as ovarian cancer, breast cancer, pancreatic cancer and prostate cancer that is caused or relapsed due to certain gene mutations (like BRCA, HER-2 negative genes). It can be used as a single agent or in combination with other anticancer agents for effective management.

It contains a medicine called Olaparib which is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes which is required for the cancer cells to grow and multiply.

LUPIPARP 100 TABLET should be used under careful medical supervision. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking LUPIPARP 100 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During therapy with LUPIPARP 100 TABLET, your doctor will schedule blood tests regularly in order to evaluate the effectiveness of this medicine and to avoid side effects. Make sure you take all the blood test recommended by your doctor. Do not drink grapefruit juice along with this medicine, as it may affect the way this medicine works.

LUPIPARP 100 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women, as it could harm the unborn baby or nursing infant. Women of childbearing potential must use a very effective contraceptive (hormone medicines and condoms) to avoid pregnancy while on therapy with Olaparib. Men must also use condoms to avoid sexual exposure of Olaparib to their female partners even if they are pregnant.

Before taking LUPIPARP 100 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking LUPIPARP 100 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, tiredness, weakness, indigestion or heartburn, loss of appetite, diarrhea, upper stomach pain, low RBC, WBC and platelet levels, headache, Changes in taste of foods, skin rashes and mouth ulcers. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIPARP 100 TABLET

Management of following types of cancer such as:

Ovarian cancer
Breast cancer
Pancreatic cancer
Prostate cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIPARP 100 TABLET Works

LUPIPARP 100 TABLET contains Olaparib which is an effective anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called PARP (poly ADP-ribose polymerase) within the cells, which is responsible for repairing damaged genetic material (DNA) in both normal and cancerous cells.

Since cancers originated due to gene mutations (like BRCA or HER-2 negative gene mutation) contains damaged DNAs in the cells, PARP is required by the cancer cells to repair the damaged DNA and for subsequent proliferation. By blocking the actions of PARP, Olaparib stops cancer cells from repairing their DNA, causing them to die while leaving normal cells less affected.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPIPARP 100 TABLET

Take LUPIPARP 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of the disease. Do not stop taking LUPIPARP 100 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET

NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET contains Sorafenib which belongs to the group of medicines called Multikinase inhibitors. It is used to manage liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma), and kidney cancer (advanced renal cell carcinoma) at an advanced stage when standard therapy has not helped to stop the disease or considered unsuitable. NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET is also used to manage differentiated thyroid cancer that is not responding to radioactive iodine management.  

NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with squamous cell lung cancer.  NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney disease, high blood pressure, and heart diseases such as abnormal heart rhythm disorders like prolonged QT interval, diabetes, and bleeding problems. Consult your doctor before taking NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET

NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy or if you think you could become pregnant, use adequate contraception during management with this medicine. NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it interferes with the growth of the developing baby. Contact your doctor for advice before taking NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET  

The safety and efficacy of NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET in children and adolescents aged below 18 years have not yet been established. NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney failure. Contact your doctor before taking NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET. The most common side effects of taking NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, constipation, weakness or tiredness, hair loss (alopecia) or rash. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage kidney cancer (advanced renal cell carcinoma)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET
Manage liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma)
Manage kidney cancer (advanced renal cell carcinoma)
Manage thyroid cancer (differentiated thyroid carcinoma)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET Works

NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET is an oral multi-kinase inhibitor which blocks tumour cell growth. It targets several enzymes on the surface of cancer cells and also targets within the cell. Several of these targets are thought to be involved in angiogenesis (making of blood vessels). NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET works by slowing down the rate of growth of cancer cells and cutting off the blood supply that keeps cancer cells growing.
usageDetails:
How to use NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET

Take NEXAVAR 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About X MAB 100MG INJECTION

X MAB 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). X MAB 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving X MAB 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

X MAB 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving X MAB 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with X MAB 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION

ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

ENFIERA 100MG INJECTION is a monoclonal antibody. It destroys the immune cells (B-cells) that triggers cancer formation. It also reduces the production of certain chemicals within the body (such as rheumatoid factor, T-cells, cytokines) that causes inflammation, pain and swelling which helps in managing various autoimmune diseases.

introduction:
Introduction About IMATINIB 0MG TABLET

IMATINIB 0MG TABLET contains Imatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in adults, children and adolescents to manage chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named myeloid cells) start growing out of control) and philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (Ph-positive ALL) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named lymphoblasts) start growing out of control).

Also, it is used in adults only to manage myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative diseases (MDS/MPD) (a group of blood diseases in which some blood cells start growing out of control), hyper eosinophilic syndrome (HES) and/or chronic eosinophilic leukaemia (CEL) (a blood diseases in which some blood cells (named eosinophils) start growing out of control), gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST) (cancer of the stomach and bowels) and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) (cancer of the tissue beneath the skin in which some cells start growing out of control).

Before taking IMATINIB 0MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney, liver or heart problems, hepatitis B infection and thrombotic microangiopathy (symptoms include bruising, bleeding, fever, fatigue and confusion).

IMATINIB 0MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. IMATINIB 0MG TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IMATINIB 0MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, weight gain, loss of appetite, disturbed sense of taste, blurred vision and weakness. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

IMATINIB 0MG TABLET is a protein-tyrosine kinase inhibitor. Tyrosine kinases are proteins which act as chemical messengers that are used by the cancer cells to signal each other for their growth, therefore this medicine works by blocking the enzyme which stops the cancer cells from growing.

introduction:
Introduction About ERLONAT 150MG TABLET

ERLONAT 150MG TABLET contains Erlotinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It is used in adults to manage non-small cell lung cancer at an advanced stage, as initial therapy (or as therapy if disease remains largely unchanged after initial chemotherapy, provided your cancer cells have specific EGFR mutations).

It is also used if previous chemotherapy has not helped to stop the disease and to manage cancer of the pancreas at a metastatic stage in combination with gemcitabine. Cancer can be defined as body cells beginning to grow out of control. Cells in any part of the body can become cancer cells and can spread to other areas of the body. Your doctor may perform certain blood tests prior to the management.

Avoid smoking during the management of ERLONAT 150MG TABLET, as it decreases the effect of the medicine. ERLONAT 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. Before taking ERLONAT 150MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diarrhea, glucuronidation disorder like Gilbert’s syndrome, history of peptic ulcers or diverticular disease, you use contact lenses, or have a history of eye problems (severe dry eyes, inflammation or ulcers of the cornea).

ERLONAT 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. ERLONAT 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking ERLONAT 150MG TABLET are rash, infection, loss of appetite, decreased weight, or depression. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ERLONAT 150MG TABLET Works

ERLONAT 150MG TABLET binds to the intracellular portion (tyrosine kinase) of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and inhibits its activity. EGFR is expressed on the surface of both normal as well as cancer cells. Inhibition of EGFR and its signaling significantly decreases tumor multiplication and survival, resulting in cell death.

name: LUPIPARP 150 Tablet 60's
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIPARP 150 TABLET

LUPIPARP 150 TABLET is used in the management of various types of cancer such as ovarian cancer, breast cancer, pancreatic cancer and prostate cancer that is caused or relapsed due to certain gene mutations (like BRCA, HER-2 negative genes). It can be used as a single agent or in combination with other anticancer agents for effective management.

It contains a medicine called Olaparib which is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes which is required for the cancer cells to grow and multiply.

LUPIPARP 150 TABLET should be used under careful medical supervision. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking LUPIPARP 150 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During therapy with LUPIPARP 150 TABLET, your doctor will schedule blood tests regularly in order to evaluate the effectiveness of this medicine and to avoid side effects. Make sure you take all the blood test recommended by your doctor. Do not drink grapefruit juice along with this medicine, as it may affect the way this medicine works.

LUPIPARP 150 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women, as it could harm the unborn baby or nursing infant. Women of childbearing potential must use a very effective contraceptive (hormone medicines and condoms) to avoid pregnancy while on therapy with Olaparib. Men must also use condoms to avoid sexual exposure of Olaparib to their female partners even if they are pregnant.

Before taking LUPIPARP 150 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking LUPIPARP 150 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, tiredness, weakness, indigestion or heartburn, loss of appetite, diarrhea, upper stomach pain, low RBC, WBC and platelet levels, headache, Changes in taste of foods, skin rashes and mouth ulcers. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIPARP 150 TABLET

Management of following types of cancer such as:

Ovarian cancer
Breast cancer
Pancreatic cancer
Prostate cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIPARP 150 TABLET Works

LUPIPARP 150 TABLET contains Olaparib which is an effective anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called PARP (poly ADP-ribose polymerase) within the cells, which is responsible for repairing damaged genetic material (DNA) in both normal and cancerous cells.

Since cancers originated due to gene mutations (like BRCA or HER-2 negative gene mutation) contains damaged DNAs in the cells, PARP is required by the cancer cells to repair the damaged DNA and for subsequent proliferation. By blocking the actions of PARP, Olaparib stops cancer cells from repairing their DNA, causing them to die while leaving normal cells less affected.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPIPARP 150 TABLET

Take LUPIPARP 150 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without food.

introduction:
Introduction About BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION

BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION contains Bevacizumab, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used in adult patients with fluoropyrimidine (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic cancer in the large bowel (colon or rectum). It is also used with Paclitaxel or Capecitabine (chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic breast cancer in adult patients.

BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION is used with a chemotherapy regimen containing platinum to manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer without epidermal growth factor receptor (a mutated protein responsible for causing cancer in a cell) and with Erlotinib (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor (in cancer cells) in adult patients.

This medicine is indicated for use to manage metastatic kidney cancer along with interferon (chemotherapy medicine), which is also indicated for use with carboplatin, gemcitabine, and/or carboplatin and Paclitaxel (chemotherapy medicine) to manage recurrent advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in adult patients.

This medicine is also used to manage persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with or without Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, or Paclitaxel and Topotecan in adult patients. BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Bevacizumab, Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell products, and/or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have recently undergone major operations or surgery.

Before receiving BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for an invasive dental management or surgery and/or suffer from conditions such as inflammation inside the abdomen, uncontrolled high blood pressure, dental problems, kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatic injury).

BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or in women planning for pregnancy since it may cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also not recommended for use by breast-feeding women since it may interfere with the growth and development of the baby.

BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the safety and efficacy of the medicine are not established in this age group. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION are constipation, loss of appetite, fever, eye problems (such as an increase in the production of tears), changes in speech or sense of taste, runny nose, and/or loss of body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION Works

BEVACIREL 400MG INJECTION works by reducing microvascular growth of tumour blood vessels which leads to reduced blood flow to the tumour cells resulting in its death thus managing the disease and managing its spread to other parts of the body in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About MABALL 100MG INJECTION

MABALL 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). MABALL 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving MABALL 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

MABALL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving MABALL 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with MABALL 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: BONITAR 400 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BONITAR 400 TABLET

BONITAR 400 TABLET is an oral targeted therapy used for managing Philadelphia chromosome -positive chronic myeloid leukemia (Ph+ CML) in adult patients. It works by blocking specific proteins called tyrosine kinases, which are responsible for the uncontrolled growth of leukemia cells.

By inhibiting these proteins, bosutinib helps slow or stop the progression of cancer, improving long-term outcomes for patients who may not have responded well to other treatments.

This medication is usually taken once daily with food to enhance absorption and reduce the risk of stomach-related side effects. It is essential to follow the prescribed dosage carefully and attend regular medical check-ups to monitor blood counts, liver function, and overall response to therapy.

Grapefruit and grapefruit juice should be avoided, as they can increase the risk of side effects by affecting how bosutinib is processed in the body.

While BONITAR 400 TABLET is an effective therapy, it can cause side effects such as diarrhea, nausea, liver enzyme abnormalities, and low blood cell counts. Patients should inform their doctor about any existing health conditions, including liver, kidney, or heart problems, to ensure safe use.

Regular monitoring and supportive care can help manage potential side effects, improving the overall treatment experience. Always consult a doctor before starting or stopping bosutinib to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BONITAR 400 TABLET
Blood Cancer (Ph-positive Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia)
mechanismOfAction:
How BONITAR 400 TABLET Works

BONITAR 400 TABLET is a targeted therapy for chronic myeloid leukemia which works by blocking the growth of cancer cells in a specific way.

In people with CML, the body makes too many abnormal white blood cells because of a faulty protein called BCR-ABL kinase. This protein tells the leukemia cells to grow uncontrollably, making it hard for healthy blood cells to function properly.

Bosutinib stops this faulty protein from working, which:

Slows down or stops the growth of cancer cells
Allows healthy blood cells to grow normally again
Helps control the disease and improve symptoms

Unlike traditional chemotherapy, Bosutinib specifically targets leukemia cells and has fewer effects on normal cells, reducing the risk of some side effects.
usageInstructions: Take bosutinib once daily at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels.?
Always take bosutinib with food to enhance absorption and reduce potential gastrointestinal side effects. ?
Swallow the tablets whole; do not cut, crush, or chew them.?

Insufficient Response: If there's no complete hematologic response by week 8 or complete cytogenetic response by week 12, and no severe side effects are present, your doctor may consider increasing the dose to 600 mg once daily.
Liver Impairment: For patients with liver issues, the recommended starting dose is 200 mg once daily.
Kidney Impairment: Dose adjustments may be necessary based on kidney function. Consult your healthcare provider for personalized recommendations.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Studies have shown that Bosutinib can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman. Animal studies have shown reproductive toxicities. Therefore, BONITAR 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and in women who think they are pregnant.
?Women of reproductive potential should use effective contraception during therapy and for at least two weeks after the last dose. ?
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED
Breastfeeding is not recommended while taking bosutinib and for at least two weeks after the final dose due to potential serious adverse reactions in nursing infants. ?
Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION
Patients should exercise caution when driving or operating machinery, as bosutinib can cause side effects like dizziness or visual disturbances that may impair the ability to perform these tasks safely.
Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
While specific interactions between bosutinib and alcohol are not well-documented, it's advisable to limit alcohol intake. Alcohol can affect liver function, and since bosutinib is metabolized in the liver, concurrent use may increase the risk of liver-related side effects.?
Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
Bosutinib can cause kidney problems. Therefore, before taking BONITAR 400 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of kidney issues. Regular monitoring of kidney function is recommended during therapy.
Liver
CONTRAINDICATED
Patients with liver impairment should not use bosutinib. Liver function tests should be conducted before starting treatment and monitored regularly thereafter.
Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED
Do not take BONITAR 400 TABLET if you are allergic to bosutinib or any of its ingredients.
Lungs
CONTRAINDICATED
Bosutinib may cause fluid retention, leading to swelling and, in severe cases, fluid accumulation in the lungs (pleural effusion). Therefore, BONITAR 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems. Report any new or worsening respiratory symptoms to your doctor promptly.
Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION
Bosutinib has been associated with cardiac events, including arrhythmias and QT interval prolongation. Patients with a history of heart problems should use BONITAR 400 TABLET cautiously and under close medical supervision.
Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR
The safety and efficacy of bosutinib in pediatric patients have not been established. Therefore, the use of BONITAR 400 TABLET in individuals under 18 years of age is not recommended.
Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION
Elderly patients (65 years and older) may experience more frequent adverse reactions. Close monitoring is advised, and dose adjustments may be necessary based on tolerability.

name: Reditux RA 500mg Infusion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION

REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION

It is used to manage:

Blood cancer (Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia)
Lymph cancer (Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma)
Rheumatoid arthritis (joint pain and inflammation)
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels)
Pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals)
mechanismOfAction:
How REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION Works

REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION is a monoclonal antibody. It destroys the immune cells (B-cells) that triggers cancer formation. It also reduces the production of certain chemicals within the body (such as rheumatoid factor, T-cells, cytokines) that causes inflammation, pain and swelling which helps in managing various autoimmune diseases.
usageDetails:
How to use REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION

REDITUX RA 500MG INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
